findings.reason: the following window is drawn from weekend traffic and cannot satisfy the node's own data gate, so the gate date should move to the next working day (2026-10-19) or the done-when should state the pick count as the sole precondition.
findings.text: §29's done-when needs ≥500 picks after §27's merge, but f-lmr-016 (docs/plans/lane-and-model-routing.html:308) gates dispatch at 2026-10-17 11:00Z, a Saturday; the local pick-timings log shows the weekend runs quietly (2026-10-10 Sat 235, 2026-10-11 Sun 112 — 347 picks across the whole weekend), so a node dispatched on the named day meets neither "one working day" nor 500 picks and must stop and wait

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the research doc, the §27 commit 5e31d25a0, pick-timings.jsonl, picker_selection.fallback_reason and _cached_run_time_profile all resolve, and §25's quoted p90/over-bound figures match its document to the digit.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §29's done-when conjoins "at least one working day after the merge" with "at least 500 picks recorded after it in pick-timings.jsonl", but f-lmr-016 schedules dispatch for 2026-10-17 11:00Z, a Saturday, when the measured local pick volume is ~112–235/day.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the sole write path is docs/research/the-pick-state-render-is-slow-because.html, a durable committed path, appended not rewritten; no scratchpad or node-local temporary directory is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no code symbols, ticket numbers or version tags enter source; §-labels appear only in the plan HTML, which is where they belong.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated cause (the synchronous profile rebuild §27 moved onto promotion) matches §25's evidence, the measurement mechanism reads fields that exist on the real path, and §27's landed artefacts (refresh_run_time_profile called from promotion.py:1248 after the ledger reload) are present.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §29 carries one deliverable (one dated measurement section appended to the research doc), and f-lmr-016 restates the same single goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — every `plan-section-depends-on` edge resolves to a node that exists and points the right way (§17←s14,s16; §22←s26, consistent with §22's "left behind by §26"; §27←s25 and jev-learns-from-its-routes#s5, the latter a real section), and the one relationship §29 needs (§27's landing plus a full day of post-merge picks) is carried in f-lmr-016 rather than the depends-on map because it is temporal.
